data.name: Galibah
data.gender_notes: Galibah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'glb', meaning 'to overcome, to conquer'. This name is given to a girl who is expected to be victorious and powerful in her life. The name Galibah carries the meaning “Victorious, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Galibah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Galibah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Galibah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
